name: Burlington Parks, Recreation & Waterfront Summer Camps
operator_name: City of Burlington Parks, Recreation & Waterfront
description_short: The City of Burlington runs a range of summer day camps for kids, held at city facilities, parks and schools. Named camps include Champ Camp, Cool Camp and Adventure Camp. You register online through Civic Rec.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: This is a city department overview page covering many different camps, not one camp. No season year, session dates, prices or ages are given. Those details are in the Civic Rec catalog and the Summer in Parks PDF.
Transportation is only offered for Champ Camp and Adventure Camp. For all other camps, parents handle drop-off and pick-up.
Free lunch and afternoon snack are only provided at Champ Camp, Cool Camp and Adventure Camp. At other camps, families pack their own food.
Scholarships are only for Burlington residents. State child-care subsidy is accepted only for Champ Camp, which is the only licensed camp, and families using it must register by phone.
